title: NIST AI RMF MAP 1.1 — Intended purpose and context are understood and documented
description: The intended-purpose/context control within the MAP function of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary NIST publication — hence 'Community' confidence.
framework_name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
control_text: The intended purposes, potentially beneficial uses, context-specific laws and norms, and prospective deployment settings of an AI system are understood and documented before and during development.

citations.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
citations.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires documented evidence that context-specific use cases were understood and tested.
